versions.content: The value of the EcucParameterDef . valueCon- figClass and the EcucAbstractReferenceDef . valueConfigClass at- tributes in the VSMD in case they are defined in the StMD If the valueCon- figClass attribute for an EcucParameterDef or an EcucAbstractRefer- enceDef is defined in the StMD, valueConfigClass . configClass for each valueConfigClass . configVariant in the VSMD shall be the same or higher (where PreCompile is considered to be the lowest and PostBuild the highest) as in the StMD with respect to the selected subset defined by the actually imple- mented supportedConfigVariant of the corresponding EcucModuleDef .
